outline.title: Future Forecast: The AI Shift in Portuguese Secondary Education
outline.summary: Pressured by high-stakes national exams and exorbitant private tutoring costs, Portuguese students will increasingly turn to AI as an affordable 24/7 study partner, fostering a culture of rigorous verification until localized, curriculum-aligned edtech emerges.
